_what_was_measured.latency: measured — timed on device over embedded test data, sensor detached (TEST_MODE 1)
_what_was_measured.power: measured — INA226 steady-state on the target supply rail (TEST_MODE 3)
_what_was_measured.energy: derived — measured power x measured latency, not an instrument reading
_what_was_measured.memory: measured — CCS linker summary for the production build (no UART, no debug, no repeat loop)
_what_was_measured.weight_bytes: analytical — nonzero parameters x 2 B in Q15

_caveat: Firmware busy-waits between samples rather than entering a low-power mode, so the energy figures are an upper bound for the active regime.

FastGRNN.deployed_config: low-rank (r_w=2, r_u=8) + 50% IHT sparsity + calibrated Q15, H=16, HAPT seed 0

_notes.deployed_f1: GRU and LSTM from the generated model_weights.h headers; FastGRNN from ptq_full_multiseed.json (seed 0, calibrated Q15 weights+activations), matching the checkpoint named in its header.
_notes.power_equality: The three cells' power readings sit within one INA226 LSB of each other, so power is platform-dominated rather than cell-dependent.
_notes.lstm_no_lut: 22.097 ms exceeds the 20 ms budget: without table-based activations the LSTM cannot meet the deadline even with no sensor attached.
